title: Introduce spectral-congruence canary and cutover stabilizer
author: Lena Ortiz
release_notes: Add a spectral-congruence canary detector that compares frequency-domain fingerprints across cohorts; add a cutover stabilizer to reduce flapping during noisy rollouts.
description:
Context and motivation: We've seen recurring short-lived regressions that are not well-captured by time-domain percentile comparisons alone. Some regressions manifest as subtle periodicity or harmonic energy shifts in tail latency/throughput time series that correlate weakly across cohorts, which cause noisy canary signals and frequent false-positive rollbacks. This PR introduces the 'spectral-congruence' detector: a frequency-domain ensemble that measures cross-cohort congruence of spectral fingerprints and a cutover-stabilizer that enforces temporal hysteresis and consensus before triggering automated rollback or throttling.

Key changes (high level):
- New detector service: perf-canary/spectral_congruence.py (core algorithm and scheduler).
- Cross-correlation pipeline: transforms cohort time-series to power spectral density (PSD), computes banded cosine similarity, and aggregates per-SLO weights.
- Cutover stabilizer: state machine in perf-canary/stabilizer.py implementing staged thresholds (observe -> warn -> safe-cutover -> block) with exponential backoff and cooldown windows.
- Metrics and alerts: new prometheus metrics (spectral_congruence_score, spectral_band_alerts, stabilizer_state) and Grafana dashboard JSON under observability/dashboards/spectral-congruence.json.
- E2E integration: a new canary-e2e test harness scenario that injects harmonic noise into tail latency streams to verify detection and non-flapping behavior.
- Docs: architecture note and runbook in docs/canaries/spectral-congruence.md and runbooks/spectral-cutover-playbook.md.

Review conversation summary (selected highlights):

CI and rollout:
- Initial CI run (2026-01-20): unit tests passed, integration canary-e2e failed intermittently due to a flaky network timing in harness. Failure: canary-e2e/test_harmonic_injection timed out.
- Rerun CI after fix (2026-01-22): adjusted harness timeouts and added retry in test harness; all checks passed (lint, unit, integration, terraform validate).
- Staging rollout: rolled to staging for 48h on Canary tenants group B; observed stabilized rollouts with fewer spuriously blocked cutovers. Metrics recorded in perf-canary: spectral_congruence_score reduced noisy alerts by ~62% during the window.

Operational guidance (summary):
- Default thresholds tuned conservatively: require spectral_congruence_score > 0.72 for 3 consecutive windows and a minimum cohort traffic of 100 rps before warn state.
- Cutover stabilizer enforces a 15-minute cooldown after a forced block and uses exponential backoff (1m -> 2m -> 4m -> 8m) between state promotions to prevent thrashing.
- Runbook: see runbooks/spectral-cutover-playbook.md for triage steps, metrics to inspect, and rollback instructions.

Compatibility and limitations:
- This detector complements existing percentile/fingerprint detectors; it does not replace them — it provides an orthogonal signal that helps identify periodic or oscillatory regressions.
- Not recommended for cohorts with extremely irregular traffic (<10 rps) due to poor PSD fidelity. We gate detection based on minimum traffic.
